expectations.text: Asks the batched interview questions or writes each assumption in a table with the step it drives (what runs in CI, CI share and runner mix, auth model, existing actions, fork-PR needs, deadline and owner), marking the plan provisional on them.
expectations.evidence: Section 0 table A1–A8 with 'Drives' column; 'The plan is provisional on every row.'

expectations.text: Deletes the container action option because customers run Windows and macOS runners and container actions run on Linux only.
expectations.evidence: 'Runs on Linux only. Windows runners cannot run it... macOS runners cannot run it'.

expectations.text: Deletes the reusable workflow as the product because callers refuse to hand `runs-on` and permissions to a third party and Marketplace cannot list it.
expectations.evidence: 'Callers will not hand runs-on and permissions to a third party. Marketplace cannot list it.'

expectations.text: Chooses the default shape: a `setup-tlw` action plus a thin `tlw-action` task action over the same CLI, in two public repos, because Marketplace lists only a root `action.yml`.
expectations.evidence: Repo 1 setup-tlw, Repo 2 tlw-action; 'Both repos get a root action.yml, which Marketplace requires.'

expectations.text: Chooses a composite action with all logic in the `tlw` CLI, and names the conditions that would move it to JavaScript: a `post:` cleanup step, native `getIDToken`, annotations at volume, or Windows logic shell cannot carry.

expectations.text: Requires a tested Windows path for every composite step (`shell: pwsh` or Git Bash with its own paths and tools) and `Get-FileHash` for verification on Windows runners.

expectations.text: Rejects `curl | bash` of the installer at runtime; downloads a version-pinned release binary and verifies it against per-version digests committed in the action repo or a signature checked against a pinned signer.

expectations.text: Defaults the CLI version to the newest version the action release ships digests for, so a new CLI version means a new action release, and accepts `latest` only on the signature-verification path resolved from Tallowick's own version endpoint, never the rate-limited GitHub API.

expectations.text: Caches the binary in the runner tool cache (`RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE`) keyed by version and architecture.
